title: Parent Additions in a Disability Compensation Release After Suspension
content:
The parent additions in a Disability Compensation resumption release are as many parent additions as the parent maximum of 2 when the award records at least 2 dependent parents, one parent addition when it records exactly one dependent parent, and nothing when it records none. They are taken from the award's own tier and form part of the monthly amount for every month the release covers.

Dependent parents recorded are the parent additions on the award less the parent removals.

**Boundary illustration (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (60% Combined Rating))**

| Parents recorded | Monthly parent additions |
|---|---|
| 0 | Nothing |
| 1 | 106.13 |
| 2 | 212.26 |
| 3 | 212.26 (the maximum of 2) |
